visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of product cards with badge, title, description, details link and image
visualCharacteristics.description: White background, 48px padding. Red small eyebrow 'Vrei să vezi ceva fresh?', centered H2. Horizontal category slider (14 round icons + labels, first active in red). 3-col grid of grey product cards with red 'NOU' badge, title, short text, 'VEZI DETALII' link and product image on red curved shape. Centered outlined CTA 'Vezi toate produsele'.

contentPattern.structure: one row per product; cell 1 = product image only; cell 2 = optional badge paragraph (e.g. "Nou") before the title, title (heading or bold paragraph), description, details link
contentPattern.description: Repeating grid of 9 product cards with badge, title, description, link and image.

usage: Product listing grid (1 column on mobile, 2 at 600px, 3 at 900px). The whole card is clickable through its details link.
reuseGuidance: Use for product/menu items. For category navigation use cards-category.
